divergences: Conflict-free bank/offset map: both committed an XOR-fold but the spec never pins the paper's actual bank()/offset() functions, so the specific folding (impl2's bank(i)=(i&7)^((i>>3)&7)^… vs impl1's unstated fold) is reproduction-invented and could differ.

Per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s: impl1 carries a committed XOR-fold permutation; impl2 implements only the bank-distinctness property with no explicit sigma_s table — the spec leaves the permutation undefined.

Twiddle-ROM addressing: both fell back to a bit-reversed psi-power table (addr=bitrev10(2^stage+block)), in residual tension with the claimed no-bit-reversal datapath; the rearranged-loop f(stage,block) addressing is source-missing.
FSM transition table: spec lists three contradictory FSM tables; impl1 picked the 'committed' IDLE→LOAD→RUN_STAGE→…→DONE walk, impl2 a minimal reconstruction — the exact state machine is open.
Barrett conditional-subtract count: impl1 fixes exactly 2; impl2 proves ≤2 over the full range — the spec doesn't pin the corrected residual bound (r in [0,3q) vs [0,2q)).
Tier-2 small-instance choice: impl1 reduces to N=8,q=17,psi=3; impl2 keeps the real q=12289 at small N — divergent because the spec only pins the production instance.
Forward/inverse butterfly convention: both used CT/DIT fwd + GS/DIF inv but the spec pins only 'DIT, merged psi-twist', so the inverse decimation is a shared guess, not specified.

structural_findings: The signature contribution — the conflict-free bank/offset mapping — is reproduction-invented (XOR-fold), not the paper's Sec.III functions; the two impls even fold differently.
Per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s is absent (impl2) or a committed guess (impl1), so the interleaved-BRAM↔lane topology is not the paper's.
Twiddle addressing uses a bit-reversed ROM rather than the paper's rearranged twiddle-reuse loop, contradicting the advertised no-bit-reversal datapath.
Pipeline-latency depth (mult3+addsub1+Barrett4+reg1=9) is cited but not realized as a timed datapath; the functional models are combinational.
Host/PCIe DMA + AXI-Stream boundary is entirely invented (paper presents only an NTT core).

summary: Reproducibility is mid: every functional parameter (N=1024, q=12289, 14-bit, psi/omega/Ninv, Barrett mu/k, 8 BUs, radix {2,4}, negacyclic) is pinned and both impls converge on a verifiably-correct NTT/INTT engine, but the paper's CENTRAL contribution — the conflict-free bank/offset map, crossbar permutation, rearranged twiddle addressing — is source-missing, so the impls diverge on invented schemes and the FSM is given three contradictory ways. Fidelity is correspondingly capped: the implementations are a faithful negacyclic NTT with the right numbers, yet the conflict-free mapping, no-bit-reversal datapath, twiddle-reuse loop, and all resource/ATP savings (the things that make this CFNTT specifically) are either reproduction-invented or unverifiable in functional code.

FSM concrete walk -> committed IDLE->LOAD->RUN_STAGE(*)->NEXT_STAGE->[SCALE if INTT]->STORE->DONE->IDLE (spec lists three contradictory FSM tables; used the 'committed' one)
Negacyclic forward transform definition for the golden -> evaluation at odd powers of psi / schoolbook mult mod (x^N+1) (transform_flavor was 'unstated in source', spec assumes negacyclic)
Radix-4 j-rotator value -> j = psi^512 (order 4, j^2=-1); used as concrete constant in the algebraic identity check

FSM transition table -> minimal reconstruction; NTT skips SCALE, INTT passes through SCALE(Ninv) before STORE
